resources.string: Show server policy decisions in Log. Entries can contain matching domain names and destination IP addresses.
Receives dynamic split include/exclude from ocserv at connection. Server policy takes priority; no local lists are needed.
Optional: only used when the server sends no domain policy. Routes included domains through VPN.
Example: example.com, internal.example.org. Includes subdomains. Separate names with commas, spaces or newlines. No URLs or ports. At least one include is required.
Manual fallback exceptions inside include domains. More specific suffix wins; exclude wins ties. Server exclude rules are received automatically and do not use this field.
Uses system DNS through the VPN. Private DNS and app-specific encrypted DNS can bypass domain rules. Turn them off for testing. TCP/UDP traffic is supported; this build needs real-device validation.
